newsitem.title: USA: Wavetech Inc in pact with Switch.
newsitem.headline: Wavetech Inc in pact with Switch.

text.p: Wavetech Inc said Wednesday it has signed a licensing agreement with Switch Telecommunications Pty Ltd of Australia.

Under the agreement Switch will use Wavetech's 'Interpretel System' in Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia and the Indian Subcontinent. Switch will pay a royalty fee and a license fee based on gross revenues derived from subscribers.
Wavetech said in a statement the two companies have also exchanged common share equities with a combined value of $4.633 million U.S. dollars.
